actual_scope: Complete 135-line display source and fixed score contract tail only; no scientific bytes, images, renderer/scorer/verifier/model execution.
checks: Exact current scoring_01 receipt path and caller SHA, COMPLETE status, all target IDs [20,21,22,23], unrun IDs empty, new_method_validated false
Exactly both A0 and yaw_plus5 PNGs for every target, fixed canonical paths, file SHA, PNG/RGB/576x576, decoded pixel SHA
Each source pasted at native 576 resolution below 64-pixel header; verification-only crop compares exact source bytes; no output crop/resize/warp/filter or match-based selection
Every panel labels MODEL-GENERATED and not a real photograph; A0 label reused baseline, yaw +5 degrees
Four 1152x640 pairs and one 1152x2560 sheet; frozen file/pixel SHA provenance; create-only output and FAILED_PRESERVED after rendering errors
limitations: Source review only: actual pixels, fonts, placement and output SHA remain future runtime evidence.

Prevalidation/source/font/image-read errors occur before visuals_01 and internal try/finally; root external receipt must retain such failures. Internal started_utc covers output preparation after source decoding, not entire process.
Output pixel SHA hashes the in-memory composed canvas and output file SHA hashes saved PNG; independent decoding of final PNG is not performed by this script. Ordinary lossless PNG write is used.
No conclusion about camera response, model quality, feature correspondence truth or method validation.
